prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. This is the one final substantive image-generation correction of a medieval RPG portrait.
Image 1 is the v1 portrait to REDRAW; Images 2-5 are Mara, Iwo, Leiya and Tore, the authoritative pixel portrait style and proportions. Recompose Image 1, not a simple filter or recolor. Keep the same character, hair/headgear and clothing identity. Do NOT keep v1's broad bright eyes or long bare neck.
Deliver ONE tight head portrait, true transparent background, 74:100 vertical aspect ratio, intended logical grid 74x100. Face must become larger in relation to hair and clothing. On the conceptual 100-row canvas: full head/hair crown starts around row 3, brows near 28-32, tiny eyes near 35-39, chin around row 88-90, only 3-4 rows of visible neck and 6-8 rows of a narrow collar at bottom. No shoulder span or chest. Avoid a small face inside huge hair. Keep the face long enough for mature adult bones.
CRITICAL EYES: strongly narrow the eye opening to short dark brown horizontal slits beneath the brow; each eye is only about 4-5 logical pixels wide and 1-2 pixels tall. The sclera is at most ONE very dim brown-gray pixel, not a white patch. Remove round visible eyeballs, bright sclera, eyelashes, eyeliner, shiny eye highlights. The eyes must be as small, dark and restrained as Mara/Iwo/Leiya/Tore.
Use a few large angular flat pixel clusters for the cheekbones, nose bridge, nose tip and jaw; merge detailed contours into bold contiguous planes. Approximately 24-32 muted colors. All edges follow a consistent logical low-resolution grid, no gradients, antialiasing or dithering. Hair must be only 5-7 large dark masses, not many long parallel highlight ribbons or fine locks. No polished painted texture.
REAL SOURCE FRAMING: keep ALL hair, crown, visible ear, braid/scarf knot and tails completely inside the raw output. Leave at least 3 logical pixel columns of completely transparent space on left and right and 3 rows on top, not a last-minute border added around a clipped contour. Entire silhouette must be intact. No background, text, border, watermark, hands, props, other people or story outcome.
Character-specific invariants and correction:
Ele, DEN-NPC-ELE, healthy sun-tanned ADULT woman around 20. Keep deep chestnut side-parted hair with the tight braid close behind the right neck, complete compact braid tip; ochre work tunic, old pale ivory shoulder cloth reduced to a tiny narrow bottom edge, tiny muted gray-blue old apron edge. Expression: firm flat closed mouth, directly self-possessed gaze, straight assertive brows, slight questioning asymmetry. She is alert and self-determining, not frightened, sad, coy or smiling. Young adult angular nose and cheekbones, no crows-feet, no forehead wrinkles, no baby-face. Crucial: shortening the bare neck must allow the face to occupy substantially more of the image; do not simply scale the existing long-neck portrait down. Keep her brown braid recognizable without filling the side with decorative hair.
